_comment: Template for a track's config.json: tools/scaffold.py copies it into builds/<slug>/ and fills in the track's name, map frame, timing, place and detail settings from tracks/<slug>/track.json. Values here are the pipeline's defaults (proven on the reference hill-climb builds); keys starting with _ are notes.

dem._comment: veneto_provinces / geodbt_lots: the Veneto province codes and GeoDBT lots the map covers (024 Vicenza, 023 Verona); tools/scaffold.py drops both outside Veneto

roads._offroad_comment: Footpaths are not exported on this map (hill climb); tracks only near the climb (tracks_near_route_m).

game_widths._comment: Narrow hill lanes: drivable widths per class when nothing better is known (the climb gets traced / GeoDBT-measured widths).

roads._climb_max_grade: trace_climb.py's limit on the grade over 10 m (reference 0.17). The LiDAR shows 19.8 % over 50 m on the reference climb (6.45 km), so 0.17 flattened real ramps by up to 2 m.
roads._climb_sv: climb_sv_measured: survey widths measured on the Street View road patches (sv_widths.py); the traced width stays within climb_sv_tol below / climb_sv_tol_up above them. climb_max_grade: steepest grade over 10 m the profile may keep (0.21: the reference climb's LiDAR shows 19.8 % over 50 m)

detail_areas._comment: Measured carriageway widths / crop map for every paved road in these boxes.

assetto_corsa._comment: Assetto Corsa only: the road is widen_m wider than surveyed (less near houses / other legs).
assetto_corsa._exposure: ksAmbient / ksDiffuse of every material x this (export_ac.py); an earlier build's 0.7 looked over-exposed in game
assetto_corsa._rock: rock_slope / rock_slope_layer: faces steeper than this (deg) become rock (where the land cover maps rock); rock_tint: colour of the rock photo (dark tint for volcanic soil; grey for limestone)
assetto_corsa.ui_credits: Built from open data (see the build README) and OpenStreetMap (ODbL). Private track.
assetto_corsa._csp_trees: 3D trees near the road for Custom Shaders Patch (ac_csp_tree_models.py in Blender, ac_trees.py, ac_csp_trees.py); false = cards only
assetto_corsa._pitboxes: Cars that can join (online: MAX_CLIENTS <= this). Slots are on the road before the start line, two staggered columns where it is wide enough (ac_track.py).
assetto_corsa._ui: ui_description (defaults to level_description), ui_credits, ui_tags, ui_run, version: ui/ui_track.json (export_ac.py)
assetto_corsa._timezone_id: IANA time zone of the track for CSP's sun ([WEATHER_FX] in data/surfaces.ini); tools/scaffold.py sets it from the country

_terrain: terrain_size_px (a power of two) x meters_per_px: the terrain grid, centred on center_utm in crs; the AC terrain is a triangulation of it, finer near the road (ac_track.py)
_track: level_name (folder / kn5 name), level_title, level_description, level_authors: the Assetto Corsa track's name and texts
